title: The Bronze Altar and Courtyard

questions.question: What was the altar of burnt offering made of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:1-2 (ESV): "You shall make the altar of acacia wood... You shall overlay it with bronze."

questions.question: What was the courtyard enclosed by?
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:9 (ESV): "You shall make the court of the tabernacle. For the south side there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen."

questions.question: What oil was used for the lamp?
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:20 (ESV): "You shall command the people of Israel that they bring to you pure beaten olive oil for the light."

questions.question: How was the lamp to burn?
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:21 (ESV): "Aaron and his sons shall tend it from evening to morning before the Lord."

questions.question: What shape was the altar?
options: Square, five cubits by five cubits
questions.correctAnswer: Square, five cubits by five cubits
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:1 (ESV): "You shall make the altar... five cubits long and five cubits broad. The altar shall be square."

questions.question: What features were on the four corners of the altar?
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:2 (ESV): "You shall make horns for it on its four corners."

questions.question: How high was the altar?
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:1 (ESV): "And three cubits shall be its height."

questions.question: What were the pillars of the courtyard set in?
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:10 (ESV): "Its twenty pillars and their twenty bases shall be of bronze."

questions.question: How long was the courtyard?
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:9,18 (ESV): "A hundred cubits long for one side."

questions.question: Where was the lamp to be tended?
options: In the tent of meeting, outside the veil
questions.correctAnswer: In the tent of meeting, outside the veil
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:21 (ESV): "In the tent of meeting, outside the veil that is before the testimony."

questions.question: What utensils were made for the altar?
options: Pots, shovels, basins, forks, and fire pans of bronze
questions.correctAnswer: Pots, shovels, basins, forks, and fire pans of bronze
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:3 (ESV): "You shall make pots for it to receive its ashes, and shovels and basins and forks and fire pans."

questions.question: What was the grating of the altar made of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:4 (ESV): "You shall also make for it a grating, a network of bronze."

questions.question: How wide was the courtyard?
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:12-13 (ESV): "The breadth of the court on the west side... fifty cubits."

questions.question: What was the height of the courtyard hangings?
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:18 (ESV): "The height five cubits of fine twined linen."

questions.question: What was this lamp command described as?
options: A statute forever throughout their generations
questions.correctAnswer: A statute forever throughout their generations
questions.explanation: Exodus 27:21 (ESV): "It shall be a statute forever to be observed throughout their generations."

key_verse_text: You shall command the people of Israel that they bring to you pure beaten olive oil for the light, that a lamp may regularly be set up to burn.
